paragraphs: At the end of Jerusalem Talmud Terumot and in Shabbat, chapter 2, halakhah 1, he did work for R' Chiyya of Tzippori.[^1]

notes.text: סוף תרומות gives end of Terumot without an invented numbered unit; פ״ב ה״א gives Shabbat chapter 2 halakhah 1. No named edition is independently checked. Did-work-for preserves עבד עבידתא אצל without promoting it to a teacher-student relation. Of Tzippori translates ציפוראי without independently establishing residence. Chananyah has no supplied title; Chiyya remains R'.
